name: Perspective
source:
As your childhood friend Suyika tries to painfully wake you up, threatening a kiss if you don't, you feel something different... Something has changed since yesterday... As you go on with your day, you make new friends and have lots of fun... but then you encounter a strange dream which the character seems unable to remember... What happens next you ask? Why don't you play and find out...

[From [url=https://icy1412.itch.io/perspective]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
儿时好友Suyika试图把你叫醒，动作粗暴得让你觉得疼，还威胁说你不起床就亲你。你感觉有些异样……自从昨天起，似乎有什么变了……随着一天过去，你结识了新朋友，也玩得很开心……但随后你做了一个奇怪的梦，似乎连梦中的角色也无法记住它……接下来会发生什么？来玩游戏看看吧……

[摘自[url=https://icy1412.itch.io/perspective]Itch.io[/url]]
